raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

LTX-2.3 one-stage uses multi-guidance (video/audio CFG + STG + modality), so each denoise step runs **4 DiT passes**: cond, neg, perturbed, modality.

`LTX2Pipeline` on LTX-2.3 takes the legacy one-stage path (`_should_use_ltx23_legacy_one_stage`), which had two problems:

- It excluded itself from CFG parallel: `stage1_cfg_parallel = enable_cfg_parallel and not use_ltx23_legacy_one_stage`.
- It ran the four passes as sequential batch-1 forwards.

The stage still declared `CFG_PARALLEL`, so the executor ran it on both ranks. With `--enable-cfg-parallel --cfg-parallel-size 2`, each rank computed all four passes, and 2 GPUs ran at the 1-GPU speed: **5.24 vs 5.23 s/step, 175.7 s per video**. 

Separately, multi-rank LTX-2 runs showed a **0–32 s gap between POST and "Sampling params"**. py-spy showed the cause:
- rank 1 was in the diffusers numpy `postprocess_video`, whose result is discarded on non-output ranks;
- rank 0 was meanwhile waiting in `broadcast_pyobj` for rank 1.

## Modifications

Three commits:

1. **Split the legacy one-stage guidance passes across CFG-parallel ranks.**
   - The legacy path now builds the same four `LTX2GuidancePassSpec` entries as the shared guidance code.
   - Pass `i` goes to rank `i % world_size`.
   - The per-branch x0 is combined with `_ltx2_combine_guided_x0_parallel_av`, which applies the same guider formula and order as the single-GPU path.
   - Passes still run one per forward in this commit, so 1-GPU output is bit-identical to before.
   - The old 4-forward block is removed. Most of the remaining diff is re-indentation.
2. **Batch each rank's guidance passes into one forward** with per-item `perturbation_configs`.
   - Perturbation masks are exact per item, so only GEMM/attention rounding moves. That is the `lossless` quality tier, which is the request default.
   - With DiT layerwise offload, this streams the weights once per step instead of once per pass.
   - `quality="exact"` keeps one pass per forward and stays bit-identical to the old schedule; it is still rank-split.
3. **Skip the LTX-2 video postprocess on non-output ranks.** Only replica rank 0 runs `postprocess_video`; other ranks return `video=None`.

New unit test `test_ltx2_cfg_parallel_guidance.py`: the rank-split combine is bitwise equal to the single-GPU combine at world sizes 2 and 4.

## Accuracy Tests

Setup: 768x512x121f, 30 steps, seed 42.

| Comparison | PSNR |
|---|---|
| `quality="exact"`, after vs before, 1 GPU and 2 GPU | identical (bit-exact) |
| Default quality, 2 GPU after vs old 1 GPU | 31.0 dB |
| Default quality, 1 GPU after vs old 1 GPU | 32.4 dB |
| Old code, own 1 GPU vs 2 GPU (reference) | 33.6 dB |

The middle frames have the same composition.

**Note:** with the default `lossless` quality, LTX-2.3 one-stage now takes the batched path on a single GPU as well, so default numerics move by rounding. If keeping the legacy default is preferred, commit 2 can be made opt-in. Commit 1 alone already gives the 2-GPU split.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Setup: RTX 5090 32 GB (SM120, PCIe, no P2P), `--dit-layerwise-offload true --layerwise-offload-components dit text_encoder` (Gemma-3 already supports layerwise offload). Client wall-clock median of 3 runs after 1 warmup run.

| Config | Before | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| 2 GPUs, `--enable-cfg-parallel --cfg-parallel-size 2` | 175.7 s (5.24 s/step) | **73.4 s** (2.30 s/step) |
| 1 GPU | 161.7 s (5.23 s/step) | **146.3 s** (4.70 s/step) |
| 2 GPUs, gap between POST and pipeline start | 0–32 s | 0 s |

Batching 4 passes on 1 GPU did not raise peak memory here, because the peak comes from the text encoder, not denoising.

## Known issues not addressed here (shared code)

- The CFG_PARALLEL executor pickles CUDA tensors to rank 1, which opens an extra ~622 MB context on GPU 0.
- With 2 GPUs, `num_frames=33` is silently adjusted to 41 even when only CFG parallel is used.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.stages.model_specific_stages.ltx_2 import (
+    denoising as ltx2_denoising,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.stages.model_specific_stages.ltx_2.denoising import (
+    LTX2DenoisingStage,
+)
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+_PASS_NAMES = ("cond", "neg", "perturbed", "modality")
+_SCALES = dict(
+    video_cfg_scale=3.0,
+    video_stg_scale=1.0,
+    video_rescale_scale=0.7,
+    video_modality_scale=3.0,
+    audio_cfg_scale=7.0,
+    audio_stg_scale=1.0,
+    audio_rescale_scale=0.7,
+    audio_modality_scale=3.0,
+)
+
+
+class TestLTX2CFGParallelGuidance(CustomTestCase):
+    """Rank-split LTX-2 multi-guidance must combine exactly like one GPU."""
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
+        self.sigma = 0.73
+        self.video_latents = torch.randn(1, 24, 16, generator=gen).bfloat16()
+        self.audio_latents = torch.randn(1, 6, 8, generator=gen).bfloat16()
+        self.video_velocities = {
+            name: torch.randn(1, 24, 16, generator=gen).bfloat16().float()
+            for name in _PASS_NAMES
+        }
+        self.audio_velocities = {
+            name: torch.randn(1, 6, 8, generator=gen).bfloat16().float()
+            for name in _PASS_NAMES
+        }
+
+    def _single_gpu(self, latents, velocities, prefix):
+        x0 = {
+            name: LTX2DenoisingStage._ltx2_velocity_to_x0(latents, v, self.sigma)
+            for name, v in velocities.items()
+        }
+        return LTX2DenoisingStage._ltx2_calculate_guided_x0(
+            cond=x0["cond"],
+            uncond_text=x0["neg"],
+            uncond_perturbed=x0["perturbed"],
+            uncond_modality=x0["modality"],
+            cfg_scale=_SCALES[f"{prefix}_cfg_scale"],
+            stg_scale=_SCALES[f"{prefix}_stg_scale"],
+            rescale_scale=_SCALES[f"{prefix}_rescale_scale"],
+            modality_scale=_SCALES[f"{prefix}_modality_scale"],
+        )
+
+    def _combine_on_rank(self, rank, world_size, all_reduce):
+        local = [n for i, n in enumerate(_PASS_NAMES) if i % world_size == rank]
+        with patch.object(ltx2_denoising, "cfg_model_parallel_all_reduce", all_reduce):
+            return LTX2DenoisingStage._ltx2_combine_guided_x0_parallel_av(
+                video_latents=self.video_latents,
+                audio_latents=self.audio_latents,
+                local_video_velocities={n: self.video_velocities[n] for n in local},
+                local_audio_velocities={n: self.audio_velocities[n] for n in local},
+                video_sigma=self.sigma,
+                audio_sigma=self.sigma,
+                **_SCALES,
+            )
+
+    def test_rank_split_matches_single_gpu_bitwise(self):
+        expected_video = self._single_gpu(
+            self.video_latents, self.video_velocities, "video"
+        )
+        expected_audio = self._single_gpu(
+            self.audio_latents, self.audio_velocities, "audio"
+        )
+        for world_size in (2, 4):
+            # First pass records each rank's all-reduce contributions; the second
+            # replays the summed tensors as the collective would return them.
+            contributions = [[] for _ in range(world_size)]
+            for rank in range(world_size):
+
+                def record(t, rank=rank):
+                    contributions[rank].append(t.clone())
+                    return t
+
+                self._combine_on_rank(rank, world_size, record)
+
+            for rank in range(world_size):
+                calls = iter(range(len(_PASS_NAMES)))
+
+                def summed(t):
+                    i = next(calls)
+                    total = contributions[0][i].clone()
+                    for other in contributions[1:]:
+                        total += other[i]
+                    return total
+
+                video, audio = self._combine_on_rank(rank, world_size, summed)
+                self.assertTrue(torch.equal(video, expected_video))
+                self.assertTrue(torch.equal(audio, expected_audio))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
